ns2:section.sectionText: Section reserved for Online students. Review of fundamentals of convective heat transfer, boiling and condensation with industrial applications, heat transfer principles for heat exchanger design and/or performance evaluations, convective heat transfer in porous media with industrial applications and numerical methods in convective heat transfer.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC, or MENG:Elec & Comp Eng ONL -UIUC.
